blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY – Three men, tagged as high-value drug suspects, were arrested with an estimated P764,000 shabu during a buy-bust operation in Barangay Estefania, in Amulung, Cagayan on Monday. Police Major Sharon Mallillin, Cagayan Valley regional police information officer, said the police arrested two butchers aged 48 and 32 and a 45-year-old Chinese translator, all of Sta. Ana town. Seized were six heat-sealed transparent plastic sachets of suspected shabu weighing 112.36-gram and with an estimated street value of P764,048. Also seized were a black sling bag, a weighing scale, unused syringe, scissors, improvised drug paraphernalia, three mobile phones, and other items. […]...
